A '''microwave sensor''',<ref name="SWS" /> also known as a '''microwave detector''' or '''Microwave Emitter/Sensor''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It was part of a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid's]] standard features,<ref name="SWS" /> being part of the equipment installed on [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO]] and [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series]] protocol droids.[[Torplex/Legends|Torplex]] manufactured the microwave sensor installed in [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drones]].<ref name="EGTD" />
